title: Add Discount
body:
Takes a percentage off the basket, for #5.

- `Discount(percent)`: the total, discounted
- outside **0–100** the total stays as it is
- table test for 0, 10, 50 and 100

```go
s.Discount(10) // 495 of 550 cents
```

comments.body: Rounds down, like Total. Looks good to me.
